experiment: Exploratory pairwise structured-loss follow-up on PoL2 contract composition

design.scope: narrow synthetic operationalization, contract v0.2; not complete PoL2
design.status: exploratory follow-up; the reused test lattice and predictions were already public before this objective was chosen
design.training_change: add pairwise hinge margin to cross-entropy: preferred action > other eligible actions; every eligible action > every ineligible action
design.model_selection: minimum validation target NLL, same rule as baseline
limitations: The test is reused from a public prior experiment; this is not independent confirmation and no hyperparameter was selected on its scores.
Only the finite synthetic contract v0.2 state lattice is tested; not the full PoL2 theory or a physical robot.
Labels and the admissible set share the same operationalization; there is no independent normative ground truth.
The test lattice contains no held-out positive transfer target.
Three matched seeds are descriptive; they do not establish a population-level causal effect.
design.history_note: Per-epoch train_nll values from the first saved run were the combined objective; relabeled train_objective during report audit because the pairwise term was included. Validation NLL remains plain cross-entropy.
